articles.title: Aston Villa: The reality of the finances available to Unai Emery at Villa Park following a summer of upheaval
articles.summary: Sky Sports News' Rob Dorsett assesses the situation at Aston Villa following a summer of upheaval and a dismal 4-0 defeat to Brighton to start the 2026/27 season; Villa feel confident Emery's future is secure but top clubs have an admiration for the Spaniard
articles.body:
All of this is a far cry from the euphoria of Istanbul in May, and that is what adds to the feeling of bemusement about how significant the changes have been to Aston Villa's squad and how quickly it has occurred.

Last season was their most successful since 1982, when they won the old European Cup.

This time round, it was a Europa League win and a fourth-place Premier League finish - each of those achievements would have been enough to guarantee the riches and prestige of Champions League football.

Unai Emery was lauded as a hero by Villa fans even before last spring's spectacular, and rightly so.

He has won the Europa League title five times with three different clubs. A key question now is whether his downbeat assessment following the humbling by Brighton is indicative of a wider concern.

Clearly, Emery was upset with Ollie Watkins, and it currently seems a tall order for the striker to be reintegrated into the Villa squad, having made his desire to leave clear.

But more worrying is the overriding sense that Emery is struggling with the lack of options he has at his disposal right now.

After all that he has achieved at the club, his reward has been widespread disruption within the squad after four key player departures, potentially more to come, and limited finances.

Emery described it as having "had an intelligent market", amid efforts by the club to strengthen the squad before the deadline. "We know where we are and we know what we want to do again for the next year," he said.

There is mitigation for Villa's bosses, however, who have been frustrated by PSR rules, which they feel have been an ambition killer and stalled their progress.

The switch to Squad Cost Ratio (SCR) rules this season has only added to that and caused deeper resentment.

As regulars in European competition now, they are limited to spending 70 per cent of their football revenue on transfer fees and player wages.

Remember, they have already been fined twice by UEFA recently, being hit with a £9.5m penalty last year and a £19.4m fine in June, although £13m of that was suspended after Villa came to a settlement agreement.

That means, inevitably, Villa are a club that has to generate income from player trading in order to buy new talent.

The proof of that is in the figures from sales over the last three years; Villa have made over £410m selling the likes of Douglas Luiz, Jhon Duran, Jacob Ramsey and Moussa Diaby, before this summer's sale of Morgan Rogers, Ezri Konsa, Youri Tielemans and Lucas Digne.

Should Emiliano Martinez and Ollie Watkins follow, that number will be close to the half-a-billion mark, in terms of funds generated.

It is a big ask for Emery to see the castle that he has built taken down keystone by keystone, knowing he has to rebuild again. Last summer, the transfer upheaval contributed to the director of football Monchi leaving the club.

Importantly, Villa currently feel confident their manager is secure. After all, his contract has another three seasons to run, following the bumper new five-year deal he signed in May 2024.

But many of the biggest clubs in Europe have noticed with admiration the job Emery has done at Villa Park, and he will always be on the shortlist of the top clubs for as long as he keeps doing such a stellar job under the circumstances.

articles.title: Se abre la vía turca para Casadó
articles.standfirst: Besiktas y otro club del mismo país, interesados en ficharle
articles.summary: Besiktas y otro club del mismo país, interesados en ficharle
articles.body: Marc Casadó dejará el Barcelona en este mercado estival. La situación está muy clara desde que, a finales de la temporada anterior, ya se le dijo que iba a tener muchos problemas para jugar en la actual. Flick tiene varios jugadores para la demarcación en la que se desenvuelve Casadó y, por si fuera poco, hace unas semanas se concretó el fichaje de Rodri, que se une a Pedri, Bernal, De Jong y Gavi. Jorge Mendes lleva todo el verano buscándole destino, pero hasta el momento nada se ha concretado. Han aparecido varios nombres, pero ninguno ha realizado la oferta definitiva. En los últimos días se ha abierto la vía turca para Casadó. Dos equipos, uno de ellos el Besiktas, que ya se interesó por él en junio, están sondeando la incorporación del centrocampista. El Barcelona quiere obtener unos 25 millones de euros por el traspaso, pero es una cantidad a la que está costando llegar a los clubes interesados. Si hace un año se habrían podido conseguir más de 30 millones por él, en este momento su cotización ha bajado después de lo poco que jugó la temporada anterior. Hay más interesados. Hay dos clubes de Arabia Saudí, uno de ellos el Al Hilal, que también están detrás del jugador. Y en los últimos días también han surgido los nombres del Sunderland y del Nottingham Forest como posibles pretendientes. Mendes sigue moviéndose en busca del destino final para Casadó.

articles.title: 2026 Fantasy Football: Smash that easy button with these 5 destination offenses that have narrow usage trees
articles.summary: The teams that employ the shortest list of contributors are the most appealing for fantasy football.
articles.body:
One of the keys to a happy adult life is learning how to deal with traffic. Maybe you're navigating a trip to the airport, or trying to find the most seamless work commute. I prefer to shop on off-peak hours, and take a late lunch in a mostly-empty restaurant. Less gridlock, more happiness.

Keep that theme in mind as you're doing your fantasy football scouting for 2026. The NFL teams that employ the shortest list of regular contributors become destination offenses for fantasy managers. Keep it narrow , keep it simple.

We want you to smash that easy button as often as possible. Let's explore a few offenses that should be fun this year, as they look to be productive regularly but tied to a limited number of contributors. These are your narrow-usage offenses for 2026.

So long as starting QB Joe Burrow stays healthy, this Cincinnati offense could go to the moon. And there won't be many seats taken on that spaceship, as almost the entire offense will be funneled through two star receivers (Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins ) and one do-it-all running back ( Chase Brown ). The Bengals have also had a horrible defense for three years running; even if it's mildly improved, pinball games are probably coming to Cincinnati. That makes the Bengals a potential carnival team as well, checking all the fun boxes.

They're not a perfect fit for this frame, as Kyren Williams and Blake Corum share backfield work (I prefer to draft Corum at cost) and the tight end room is super-crowded. But the Rams throw to their backs less than any other team, and veteran QB Matthew Stafford does very little with his legs. Puka Nacua had a robust 30.29% market share last year, and Davante Adams led the NFL in both red-zone targets and touchdown catches. The Rams don't have an impactful third WR looming on the depth chart, which means Nacua and Adams will once again be swimming in targets.

Detroit checks so many boxes when we're searching for a bankable offense. There's plenty of continuity here, a schedule heavy on indoor games and a bunch of beatable defenses coming to town. Jared Goff is a reliable veteran QB but not a runner, which is good for his teammates.

Jahmyr Gibbs will have the backfield essentially to himself this year, slotting him as the consensus No. 1 pick. Amon-Ra St. Brown is a consistency king who fits in the middle of any first round. Jameson Williams took off last year when Sam LaPorta got hurt; this summer, we once again worry about a LaPorta injury. Even if the Big 4 all remain healthy, there's plenty to go around. Keep in mind second-year WR Isaac TeSlaa has been disappointing in camp, which tightens the overall concentration.

This one is a little tricky, as the Falcons haven't solved their QB problem yet. Tua Tagovailoa has been shaky this summer, and Michael Penix Jr. hasn't shown much through two seasons. But Atlanta didn't have great QB play last year, either, and Bijan Robinson , Drake London and Kyle Pitts Sr. were all fantasy stars. Robinson and Pitts saved the best for last; Robinson was the best RB in the fantasy playoffs, and Pitts went nuclear in Week 15 (11-166-3), one of the best tight end games of all-time.

After Atlanta's Big 3 are selected, most rooms will ignore the rest of the Falcons. RB Brian Robinson Jr. is merely an insurance play (and sometimes a name-confusion click) and no support receiver here is commanding a top-200 pick. The Falcons will lean on their best players again this fall, and we like it that way.

The Dallas vibes are similar to the Cincinnati vibes, a star quarterback and productive offense trying to outscore the mediocre defense on the other side. The concentration isn't quite as tight in Dallas, as four primary players see regular work ( CeeDee Lamb , George Pickens , Javonte Williams , Jake Ferguson ), and Ryan Flournoy is an interesting third receiver. But Flournoy probably won't see a big role unless Lamb or Pickens get hurt, and QB Dak Prescott has cut back his running in the second half of his career. At the end of the day, we know where our Texas Toast is buttered.

articles.title: Pumas ficha a Chino Huerta para ‘olvidar’ a Efraín Juárez; así le ganaron a Toluca, Cruz Azul y América
articles.standfirst: El último ídolo en CU vuelve a vestirse de auriazul tras su paso europeo
articles.summary: El último ídolo en CU vuelve a vestirse de auriazul tras su paso europeo
articles.body: Pumas tiene su refuerzo para suplir la baja de Sebastián Córdova, fuera todo el torneo por lesión, y uno es un fichaje cualquiera para el equipo que hoy dirige Esteban Solari. Se trata de César Huerta, el último gran ídolo de la afición universitaria el que regresa desde el Anderlecht en un momento complicado para el club tras perder la final del torneo anterior ante Cruz Azul y la salida de Efraín Juárez. Con información de Rodrigo Celorio, que cubre al Club Universidad Nacional para TUDN, y de César Luis Merlo, especializado en fichajes, el acuerdo existe entre clubes y jugador para llevar a cabo el traspaso. “Se trata de una compra definitiva y Huerta tendrá un contrato de tres años. Este miércoles llegará a la Ciudad de México para realizarse los exámenes médicos de rigor y firmar con los universitarios”, comparte Merlo en Superdeportivo. Chino Huerta emigró en enero de 2025 al equipo de Bélgica, donde poco a poco fue perdiendo protagonismo, en parte también por las lesiones. Su venta a Europa fue por 2 millones de euros. El regreso de Huerta a la Liga MX se da con un equipo que no había sonado entre los rumores de su regreso desde Europa, ya que se mencionó con más fuerza al Toluca. Después del equipo de Antonio Mohamed, también se nombró a Cruz Azul y, en menor medida al América, ante la falta de refuerzos, pero los de la UNAM tendría de vuelta al jugador en Ciudad Universitaria. De acuerdo con información de DH Les Sports en Bélgica, Chino Huerta se rehusaba a regresar a México, pero cuando Pumas apareció en el panorama, comenzó a cambiar de idea. Los universitarios han conseguido 8 de 15 puntos disputados en las primeras cinco jornada del Apertura 2026 y se coloca en la posición 9 de la tabla, mientras que en la Leagues Cup quedó eliminado en la primera ronda.

The 2026 NFL season is fast approaching and the Yahoo Fantasy Ultra Playbook has everything you need to know to before your draft, giving you the tools and analysis to crush the competition. It's night and day for Kenneth Walker III in terms of his fantasy situation. He goes from an offense with a split backfield, and little work in the red zone, to a team whose offense is both high-scoring and lacking weapons. His contract and competition makes predicting top-12 RB volume reasonable, with opportunities in the red zone and passing game being key additions.

The fantasy obstacle for Walker has always been injuries. Although he's only missed 10 of 72 career games, only 41 of those games have come with 15+ touches due to leaving early, snap counts and coaching decisions. The 23.4 fantasy PPG in the NFL Playoffs last season is what fantasy managers hope will be what sticks from 2025. After the failed Isiah Pacheco-Kareem Hunt experiment, Andy Reid will look to go back to having a workhorse in Walker.

Can Daniel Jones come back strong? Taylor's production fell off after his quarterback's Achilles injury in 2025, production that started out as part of the No. 1 scoring offense in the NFL with a run-first mentality. JT is the definition of a bellcow RB, with underrated, career-high usage in the passing game last season. If Jones' injury causes less QB red-zone rushing and more checkdowns, Taylor could top his 2025 season easily as long as the offense can remain clicking. As one of only four running backs to be an RB1 in three consecutive seasons, he should be in for another RB1 season with high volume.

Before the J.K. Dobbins injury, the Broncos' rookie RB only handled 24% of RB carries last season. He was a TD machine that broke out in the second half of the season as the starter, although it diminished after Week 17 (the fantasy championship in most leagues). The return of Dobbins and addition of fourth-round pick Jonah Coleman makes it a more difficult path for Harvey to return to his peak. The offensive line and receiving opportunity are great, but the Broncos RB will just need to develop after a rookie season that was shaky in efficiency.

The concern is obvious: Henderson barely played in the NFL playoffs when it matters most. Four total snaps in the AFC Championship is #notgood. He is a big "if" player. If he gets 50% of the volume, that alone can be enough. If he gets 65%+ he can be a league winner. We saw it in spurts with three different top-five RB weeks alone, specifically posting RB1 numbers in his month without Rhamondre Stevenson, at 20 touches a week. His overall rushing efficiency and pass protection were sub-par, but it was his rookie season after all. If he can flirt with 15 touches per game, that'll be plenty to hit ADP in a New England offense.

Rumors of a running back by committee can hurt Pollard in a big way. Surprisingly, the Titans RB is one of three RBs to have 275+ carries in three straight seasons. Although he was relevantly efficient in 2025, the Tennessee offense held him back from any real fantasy payout. However, he has been a top-30 RB in each of the last four seasons, and should make it five if the Titans offense improves after overhauling that side of the ball.

Ben Johnson running backs have scored more than any since 2022, but Swift's production, especially in the second half of the season, surprisingly was limited to the ground game. He tied his career high in goal-line attempts but averaged a career low in targets. With Kyle Monangai increasing his workload later in the year, Swift should be an RB2 thanks to an elite rushing attack, yet with a lower ceiling compared to past seasons.

Nobody had a better offseason than 2025 fourth-rounder Bhayshul Tuten. After rumors of adding a top running back in the draft or free agency, the Jacksonville Jaguars replaced Travis Etienne Jr. with career backup Chris Rodriguez Jr. and passed on the position with all 10 of their NFL Draft selections. The volume is the X-Factor and the unknown.

If Jacksonville does use Tuten as a true 1A, he can be the biggest fantasy value in the draft. Tuten and Rodriguez both have the same strengths as inside runners and were dominant at the goal line in 2025. When it comes to receiving, Tuten has the clear advantage, although he was far behind Etienne in that department last season. With a top offense to support him and playcaller Liam Coen having the fifth-most RB fantasy points the last two seasons, Tuten is a high-upside target.

Warren is a reliable fantasy option that isn't always the most exciting draft-day selection. His efficiency has always been high, with the volume being the main eluding factor. In the Aaron Rodgers offense, RBs score plenty with a vast amount of targets available. Based on targets per route and yards per route, no RB was more efficient than Warren in 2025. Now that he's back healthy and without Kenny Gainwell, that passing involvement could be the key to fantasy success if he can beat out Rico Dowdle for that primary role.

articles.title: Borja Iglesias, baja dos semanas por una lesión en el sóleo
articles.standfirst: El delantero del Celta, reciente campeón del mundo con España, sufre una rotura miofascial en el sóleo izquierdo
articles.summary: El delantero del Celta, reciente campeón del mundo con España, sufre una rotura miofascial en el sóleo izquierdo
articles.body: Contratiempo para Borja Iglesias y para el Celta. El delantero sufrió una rotura miofascial del sóleo izquierdo y estará de baja las dos próximas semanas. El Celta lo ha hecho oficial en un comunicado, una lesión que le obligará a parar en este inicio de temporada y que le apartará de los próximos compromisos del conjunto de Claudio Giráldez. El internacional, que ya estaba previsto que disputase los últimos minutos del partido del pasado sábado en Mestalla, estaba planeado que dispusiese de ellos ya este jueves en el encuentro ante Osasuna. De esta forma, se perderá los partidos también ante Athletic, Real Sociedad y Getafe y habrá que esperar para ver si puede llegar al encuentro ante el Málaga, justo antes del parón de tres semanas. Se da la circunstancia que este domingo ofrecerá a la afición del Celta la Copa del Mundo que conquistó con la selección española este verano y no lo podrá realizar vestido de corto. Borja Iglesias se había reincorporado a los entrenamientos hace apenas quince días, tras su periodo vacacional, y el Celta se queda en este arranque liguero sin su máximo goleador las dos últimas temporadas

articles.summary: Volverá a llegar cedido por parte del Alavés con una opción de compra a final de curso
articles.body: Uno de esos jugadores que el año pasado se ganó los minutos, y también la afición, regresa al Andorra. Se trata de Jesús Owono, de quien medios de Álava y el Diari d'Andorra han avanzado su regreso en calidad de cedido procedente del Alavés. Eso sí, con una opción de compra a final de curso. El guardameta ecuatoguineano disputó la pasada temporada 21 partidos de tricolor tras destronar a Áron Yaakobishvili. Y se reivindicó. Por eso, tras valorar otros destinos, apuntan a que ha decidido repetir la apuesta por el conjunto que este año encabeza Carles Manso desde el inicio. Cabe decir que la competencia que se encontrará ahora será también de nivel, ya que Pau López ha sido el escogido para defender la portería pirenaica en las dos primeras jornadas. En cualquier caso, Owono dejó muestras durante el año que puede rendir a un muy alto nivel. En la Liga, de los 20 encuentros dejó la portería a cero en seis de ellos, mientras que en la Copa del Rey, frente al Valle de Egüés, sólo encajó un tanto. Este año no ha sido convocado por Quique Sánchez Flores en ninguno de los dos partidos de Primera que el Alavés ha disputado.

articles.title: Afcon 2028: Ethiopia submits official bid to host tournament in East Africa
articles.summary: Ethiopia submits a bid to host the 2028 Africa Cup of Nations despite lacking enough stadiums to host a 24-team tournament.
articles.body:
Ethiopia has submitted an official bid to host the 2028 Africa Cup of Nations (Afcon).

The country's football federation (EFF) says its government-backed proposal affirms "the nation's full readiness to host Africa's biggest footballing event".

Ethiopia has staged Afcon three times, in 1962, 1968 and 1976, but its footballing infrastructure lags well behind others on the continent.

The nation had just one stadium approved for use by the Confederation of African Football (Caf) last season but is in the process of inaugurating a new international stadium and sports complex in Addis Ababa.

That venue in the capital could provide one location for the tournament, but whether Ethiopia has enough compliant venues to host a 24-team Afcon across multiple locations remains a major question.

A number of existing regional facilities are understood not to meet Fifa or Caf standards in terms of infrastructure, facilities and overall match-day requirements.

Ethiopia played its home qualifiers for the 2026 Fifa World Cup at neutral venues in Morocco and Rwanda but did host matches in Dire Dawa earlier this year.

Last month, Caf president Patrice Motsepe said his organisation had received "exciting bids" for the 2028, 2032 and 2036 Afcons - with the tournament set to move to a four-year cycle after 2028 .

Botswana, Namibia, South Africa and Zimbabwe announced a joint Southern African bid for the 2028 finals earlier this year.

Despite reports that Morocco - hosts of the 2025 edition - could stage the tournament again in two years' time, BBC Sport Africa understands the kingdom is not in the running and instead is focusing on preparations to co-host the 2030 Fifa World Cup.

Meanwhile, Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger - three countries led by military governments - have expressed interest in co-hosting in 2032.

The 2027 Afcon is scheduled to take place in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda from 19 June to 17 July next year, with the competition returning to East Africa for the first time since it was held in Ethiopia in 1976.

Ethiopia won the Afcon title on home soil in 1962 but the Walia Ibex, ranked 143rd in the world and 43rd in Africa, have only qualified for the tournament three times since they last hosted.

Their most recent appearance came at the 2021 edition, when they finished bottom without a win in a group containing Cameroon, Burkina Faso and Cape Verde.

Ethiopia beat Sao Tome and Principe in the preliminary round of qualifiers for next year's Afcon and have been drawn alongside Senegal, Mozambique and Sudan in Group J.

Is holding Afcon every four years 'totally wrong' or 'good call'? Published 22 January

Is holding Afcon every four years 'totally wrong' or 'good call'?

The EFF's announcement that it wants to host Afcon has generated mixed reactions, with critics questioning whether the country is truly prepared to host a tournament of this scale.

Ethiopia was one of just three nations to play at the first Afcon in 1957, but the 52,000-seat Bahir Dar Stadium in the north of the country is currently the only facility it posseses which is approved by Caf.

Meanwhile, the 62,000-capacity Adey Abeba International Stadium in Addis Ababa is expected to be completed next year.

articles.title: Xavi, en su presentación: "Quiero que mi Países Bajos tenga el balón, soy un ganador"
articles.standfirst: El entrenador español fue presentado oficialmente por la Federación neerlandesa
articles.summary: El entrenador español fue presentado oficialmente por la Federación neerlandesa
articles.body: Xavi Hernández (XH) fue presentado oficialmente por la Federación de Países Bajos como su nuevo seleccionador hasta el Mundial 2030. En una multitudinaria rueda de Prensa, XH compareció junto al director deportivo de la Federación, el exmundialista Nigel de Jong. Xavi se expresó en español e inglés y afrontó la rueda de Prensa con traductor al neerlandés y aceptando las preguntas de los numerosos medios que allí había.   Sus primeros deseos: "Tengo muchas conexiones con este país. La sensación es que voy a la Universidad del Fútbol. Quiero que mi Selección siempre tenga el balón, pero con pasión. Estamos aquí para competir, disfrutar y ganar. E insisto: estamos aquí para ganar". El Barça: "Estar allí fue un máster, tanto para lo bueno como para lo menos bueno. Nos nutrimos muchísimo en Can Barça del fútbol de Países Bajos y ahora es una oportunidad de devolver todo aquí". Su sistema de juego: "Sé que Van Gaal o Koeman han jugado con cinco defensas atrás. Pero ésa no es mi idea para mi equipo. Yo quiero jugar con otros sistemas: 4-3-3, 4-2-3-1 o 3-4-3. Creo que podemos dominar mejor el juego con estos sistemas".  De Jong (Barça): "Frenkie está muy motivado con nuestro fichaje. Lo primero es que ojalá se pueda recuperar bien y lo antes posible, pues es un jugador muy importante para todos". Un ganador: "Sé que soy un seleccionador extranjero. Pero estoy aquí para ayudar a la Federación, al staff y a los jugadores. Quiero ganar. Siento la presión, pero soy un ganador, y estoy listo, súperlisto". Cruyff: "¿Qué aprendí de Johan? En las etapas finales de su vida hablé mucho con él, incluso cuando estaba enfermo. Y siempre fue muy positivo, también cuando estaba enfermo. Aprendí eso. Siempre sonriendo, vibras positivas. Esto es lo que voy a mostrar a mis jugadores. Disfrutemos el proceso, y entonces estaremos más cerca de Cruyff". articles.title: Carlos Baleba: Manchester United sign Cameroon midfielder from Brighton in Â£70m deal
articles.summary: Manchester United sign Cameroon midfielder Carlos Baleba from Brighton in a Â£70m deal.
articles.body:
Manchester United have signed Cameroon midfielder Carlos Baleba from Brighton in a Â£70m deal.

The Old Trafford club have paid an initial Â£65m, plus a potential Â£5m in add-ons, for the 22-year-old, while Brighton have negotiated a sell-on clause.

United targeted Baleba after deciding to strengthen their midfield further following the summer arrivals of Andrey Santos from Chelsea and Youri Tielemans from Aston Villa .

Baleba has signed a five year-contract at Old Trafford, with the option to extend for a further year.

"It is an incredible feeling to join the club of my dreams," he said. "Playing at Old Trafford is always special, but the opportunity to do so as a Manchester United player will be a real honour.

"I cannot wait to work with Michael Carrick. His experience and knowledge of the game make him the perfect coach to help me to reach the highest level.

"The ambition of everyone at the club is extremely clear, the future is hugely exciting, and I am determined to play my part in delivering the success that we are capable of together."

Baleba's move follows United's shock 2-0 defeat by Hull City in Saturday's Premier League opener, where Santos and Tielemans made their midfield debuts.

United reignited their interest after attempting to sign him last year near deadline day, but were put off by Brighton 's valuation, which was in excess of Â£100m.

Baleba, who joined Brighton from Lille in 2023, is currently sidelined with an ankle injury he picked up during the Seagulls' pre-season training camp in Austria.

He made 112 appearances for Brighton , scoring four times, and 31 in the Premier League last season as they finished eighth to qualify for this season's Conference League.

"Last season was hard," admitted Baleba in a farewell video.

"There was a night against Aston Villa when I came off after 22 minutes. I sat in the dugout and could not lift my head up. You did not boo me. I have thought about that more than you know. You had every reason to and you did not.

"I will be looking for your result every week for the rest of my life. Thank you, Brighton fans."

The move has taken United's summer spending up to Â£153m as they prepare for a return to the Champions League for the first time since the 2023-24 campaign.

"[He is] a huge talent that the club has been trying to follow for a long time." Red Devils captain Bruno Fernandes told BBC Radio 5 Live. "Someone that can improve our team and has different qualities to what we already have in the club.

"The expectation is very high but also we know he is a player we need to give time to become an even better version of himself. We are here to help him set [in] as quick as possible and to help us win games."

What does your Premier League club still need in the transfer window? Published 8 hours ago

What does your Premier League club still need in the transfer window?

United will hope for the 2024-25 version of Baleba rather than last season's because it was his performances in that campaign that attracted them.

We can't know what would have happened if the approach for Mateus Fernandes had been successful, nor if Mason Mount had not suffered the injury in the pre-season game with Paris St-Germain two weeks ago that ruled him out of the Premier League opener.

However, even before Saturday's disappointing loss at Hull it is clear that, despite adding Santos and Tielemans to their midfield ranks, they still lack physicality and power.

In theory, Baleba should solve that issue.

The 22-year-old is strong in possession, covers ground quickly, is good in the air and alert to danger.

Crucially, he also has three years' worth of top-flight experience in England behind him, having moved to Brighton from Lille when he was 19. It gives him the edge on Santos, also 22, and it will be interesting to see whether the pair compete for the same place at the base of Michael Carrick's midfield or if, against the best sides, they might play together.

It will also be fascinating to see if he gets asked to fill in at left-back too.

He has played there before and, unlike Diogo Dalot and Noussair Mazraoui - who could also switch sides if Luke Shaw is unavailable - is left-footed.

Paul Pogba is the only midfield player United have signed for more than the Â£70m they are committing to Baleba which, given his age, is a statement in itself.

'Baleba complements United's other midfielders'

Baleba's appeal lies less in creativity and more in his ability to win possession, cover ground and then carry his team forward.

His 2025-26 campaign was quieter than the previous one, but his 2024-25 numbers show why United have tracked him for so long. He ranked fourth among Premier League midfielders for possessions won in the middle third (107) and interceptions (46), was fifth for ball recoveries (197) and seventh for duels won (199).

That defensive output was matched by his ability to progress possession himself.

Baleba averaged 6.7 progressive carries per 90 minutes, with only three qualifying Premier League defensive midfielders recording more, while 2.9 of those carries travelled at least 10 metres.

His athleticism underpins that game as he reached a top speed of 34.5km/h in 2024-25, compared with 30.5km/h for Casemiro, and averaged 8.2 defensive actions per 90.

He is not necessarily the midfielder United would rely on to dictate possession. Only 11.8% of his passes were classed as line-breaking that season and 22.7% travelled forward - both below the average for central and defensive midfielders.

But that may make him complementary to United's other options rather than a direct alternative. Tielemans can provide more of the progressive distribution, while Baleba offers defensive security and the ability to drive through midfield.

Alongside Kobbie Mainoo, he could take on more of the ball-winning and ground-covering work, while a partnership with Santos could allow Baleba greater freedom to operate box to box.

That versatility is reflected in his positioning as he spent 88% of his minutes last season as a defensive midfielder and 12% in central midfield, suggesting he can anchor the side or step forward depending on who plays alongside him.

United most commonly defended in a 4-2-2-2 last season under Carrick, accounting for 55.9% of their out-of-possession shapes. Baleba's dynamism could be especially valuable in a system where central midfielders are asked to defend large spaces and stop counter-attacks.

There may, however, be an adaptation period.

Baleba is recovering from an ankle ligament injury suffered in pre-season and will need time to recover his match sharpness.

United have also looked to spend longer spells in possession under Carrick, progressing through midfield with quick combinations. Baleba's game is better suited to more open contests, but his passing profile suggests he may need time to adjust to greater responsibility in build-up.

His left foot and mobility should still make him a natural partner for players such as Tielemans or Bruno Fernandes. There is development ahead of him at 22, not least after last season's dip, but at his best Baleba combines defensive activity with the acceleration and carrying power to transform a turnover into an attack within seconds.

articles.title: Bold College Fantasy Football predictions for the 2026 season
articles.summary: Will these six bold college fantasy football predictions come true?
articles.body:
With college football mercifully starting back up this weekend, we will finally get to see how these newly constructed rosters perform in reality as opposed to in theory. Since Yahoo College Fantasy drafts are in full swing, it's time to break out some bold CFF-oriented predictions for the 2026 season.

Jadan Baugh leads the nation in rushing yardage

A powerful-yet-graceful Man Beast, Baugh is 6'1"/228 pounds, squats 565 pounds and has a 4.57 40 speed. He was held back by the hapless Billy Napier last season but managed to score 17+ fantasy points in his last six contests following Napier's dismissal. New Florida head coach Jon Sumrall is well-known for his affinity of using his primary running back as a bell cow, as is evidenced by his prolific usage of Kimani Vidal back at Troy, with Vidal leading the entire nation in rushing under Sumrall's tutelage.

I think Sumrall unleashes Baugh on the SEC, to devastating effect, with the future top-50 NFL Draft pick finally emerging as the star he was destined to be. Baugh is a major priority for me and well worth a first-round fantasy draft selection with the workload he is projected to receive.

Jayden 'Duke' Scott takes the ACC by storm and averages 20 Fantasy PPG

Scott averaged 6.1 yards per touch with a pristine 94% catch rate as Hollywood Smothers' backup last year, and inherits the Wolfpack's starting gig heading into the season. The numbers were recounted in the indispensable Feldman Freaks List , with Scott reportedly running a 4.35s 40-yard dash while squatting 575 lbs with 20 bench reps. Those are rare numbers for a 5'10/235-pounder and well beyond what Smothers is capable of. NC State dodges Miami, Clemson and Notre Dame (honorary ACC member), leaving Scott to feast on the soft underbelly of the ACC. I think Scott clears the elite 20-PPG mark and goes on to have a top-10 College Fantasy campaign.

Ryan Coleman-Williams is a top-five scoring wide receiver

The uncomfortable truth is that Coleman-Williams' 10 drops sabotaged critical opportunities and turned a promising sophomore season into a disappointment. The talent did not vanish; he still averaged 6.8 yards after the catch, showing the same acceleration and open-field creativity that powered his freshman breakout. Now that explosive sophomore QB Keelon Russell has secured the starting job, Coleman-Williams has an Elite-11-winning signal-caller to work with.

Alabama's most difficult defensive test all season comes Oct. 11 versus Georgia, with the remainder of the schedule being very favorable from a fantasy perspective. The news out of camp is that RCW has regained his freshman magic when he reclassified as a 17-year-old in order to play in 2024. I think Coleman-Williams will correct the case of the yips he had in 2025 and ascend back into the upper crust of P4 wide receivers, finishing as a top-five scorer at the position.

Jamal Roberts finishes as a top-15 CFF running back

One of the most important contingency backs in fantasy football after averaging 6.17 yards per carry, Roberts also caught 17 passes for 139 yards and averaged 10.51 per game despite being a backup. Roberts' emergence as a quality RB2 averaging 0.97 fantasy points per touch shows he can support Missouri's offense if asked to lead it, and with breaking news indicating Ahmad Hardy is set to miss at least the first game, we could have a situation where the unfortunate gunshot victim is held back for most of the season until he is completely healthy in order to protect his NFL Draft stock.

Play Yahoo's new College Fantasy Football game: Create or join a league now!

I think Roberts gets the full workload for a Mizzou squad that averaged 228 rushing yards per game last season and returns three starters on a devastating offensive line that boasts 118 total career line starts. Whoever gets that starting job is going to produce, full stop, and I think that player is Roberts.

Omarion Miller takes the WR1 job at ASU and is a top-10 fantasy wideout

I'm a longtime fan of BC-to-ASU transfer WR Reed Harris and his ability to win downfield on the boundary. However, after watching Miller it became clear that he is simply operating at a different level and is deserving of Jordyn Tyson's high volume, alpha-WR1 role in Kenny Dillingham's offense.

Miller came on strong in his final seven games, accruing 608 of his 808 yards and 32 of his 45 receptions, as he took over the Buffs' receiving room while cashing in seven touchdowns over that span. His 34% deep target rate and 3.4 fantasy points per touch average foreshadows a massive leap in production now that he has a proven offensive guru steering the ship. Imagine what Miller is capable of now that he's away from the Colorado circus, where QB JuJu Lewis said they were essentially winging it on offense last year with no real structure.

Miller is a league-winner who is somehow being selected in the Round 8-10 range in most Yahoo Standard Leagues.

Post-hype sleeper QB Nico Iamaleava tears up the Big Ten and averages 25 fantasy points per game

Iamleava was behind the 8-ball last year after transferring late in the cycle from Tennessee to UCLA in a contentious QB swap that sent UCLA signal-caller Joey Aguilar packing to Knoxville. To compound matters, former head coach Deshaun Foster was inarguably one of the worst P4 coaching hires of the last decade, leaving Iamleava without structure and direction. The Bruins brought in new head coach Bob Chesney from James Madison, where he took the Dukes to the CFP Playoff and guided QB Alonza Barnett to an excellent 23.8 fantasy PPG season.

Skillset-wise, Iamleava is essentially a souped-up version of Barnett and was the only returning quarterback in the Power Four who rushed for 400+ yards and failed to eclipse the 20 PPG threshold. As someone who attended several UCLA games over Foster's tenure, and was also present at the Bruins spring game, I can say with confidence that Chesney has completely changed the atmosphere around the program. With Chesney resetting the roster through the transfer portal in the same manner that his JMU predecessor Curt Cignetti did at Indiana, I think UCLA hits the ground running and instantly becomes a credible Big Ten program, with Nico emerging from the post-hype-sleeper doldrums to become a top-20 scoring quarterback and CFF weapon who clears the 25 PPG barrier.

articles.title: Man Utd transfer news: Will Michael Carrick's side buy a left-back before transfer window closes?
articles.summary: After spending Â£155m on three midfielders, now Manchester United must decide whether to try to buy a left-back
articles.body:
The signing of Carlos Baleba completes a Â£155m summer revamp of Manchester United's midfield.

At the end of last season, midfield was targeted as a priority area as United looked to build on qualification for the Champions League after a two-year absence.

Baleba arrives along with Andrey Santos, a Â£48m signing from Chelsea, and Â£35m former Aston Villa man Youri Tielemans.

It means that, along with England's Kobbie Mainoo, United now have a spread of different attributes across their four-man midfield, three of whom are 22 or younger.

But, at Manchester United, one bad result brings intense pressure.

Even Michael Carrick's calm exterior cracked in a post-match exchange with former Middlesbrough and Swindon Town forward Jan Aage Fjortoft, now a TV presenter for Viaplay, following the shock defeat at Hull when the Norwegian suggested there was a lack of passion in United's ranks.

"Come on, that's ridiculous," replied Carrick. "You played football. You understand. That's a ridiculous thing to say."

So, now the midfield is sorted, it is natural for fans to look at the other areas of Carrick's squad that could do with reinforcements; namely left-back.

Baleba completes Â£70m Man Utd move from Brighton Published 11 hours ago

Baleba completes Â£70m Man Utd move from Brighton

Signing an additional left-back has looked an obvious thing for Manchester United to do.

Luke Shaw started all 38 Premier League games last season. He started at Hull. Of United's past 44 league games, the 31-year-old England international has failed to start just one, the final game of the 2024-25 campaign, four days after the Europa League final defeat by Tottenham â and he went on the post-season tour of Asia immediately afterwards.

But, before that, Shaw's injury record had not been great.

Between February 2024 and April 2025, he played as many games for England (three) as he did for his club. He missed three months at the start of the 2023-24 campaign.

articles.standfirst: El canterano ha firmado un muy buen comienzo de curso
articles.summary: El canterano ha firmado un muy buen comienzo de curso
articles.body: El 25 de agosto de 2025, Rafael Garrido se encontraba preparando la temporada con el Atlético Malagueño en Segunda RFEF. Era el titular para Juanfran Funes, pero su aparición por el primer equipo no se hacía presagiar teniendo en cuenta que Sergio Pellicer contaba en plantilla con Carlos Puga y Jokin Gabilondo en su posición. El canterano de Torre del Mar (Vélez-Málaga) no participó con los mayores hasta la jornada 8, cuando entró unos pocos minutos en la derrota del Málaga en El Sardinero por tres a cero. Desde entonces, era octubre, su progresión en el club boquerón ha sido meteórica. La siguiente jornada, la ausencia de Puga, provocó su entrada en el once adelantando a Jokin Gabilondo y siendo titular ante el líder, el Deportivo de la Coruña, en una abultada victoria malaguista por tres a cero. El joven defensa no soltó el puesto hasta la salida de Pellicer. Con Funes y su aterrizaje en el primer equipo, bajó de nuevo al filial aunque el de Loja lo reclutó pronto ante la plaga de lesiones en el lateral zurdo. A pesar de ser diestro y de tener 21 años, Rafita rompió todos los esquemas y nadie lo pudo mover del once titular del equipo hasta el ascenso final a Primera en Almería. Ahora, con el cuadro malaguista ya en la máxima categoría, el Málaga buscó reforzar el lateral zurdo y devolver a Rafita a su puesto natural. Sin embargo, a pesar del fichaje de José Salinas, el joven defensa malaguista ha ganado la partida a su par en estas dos primeras jornadas cuajando dos enormes partidos ante el Atlético de Madrid en el Metropolitano y ante el Dépor en La Rosaleda. En Madrid, en su debut en Primera ante los Baena, Lookman y compañía, Rafita cuajó una actuación notable ganando ocho de sus diez duelos en el partido y cerrando el partido como uno de los jugadores malaguistas con más metros recorridos y un excelente 88% porcentaje de pase. Unos números que no fueron casualidad después de lo visto este lunes en La Rosaleda. El lateral volvió a ser clave para Funes. En defensa ganó el 90% de los duelos y provocó la pena máxima en el área gallega que significó el gol del empate del Málaga obra de Chupete. Su estreno en Primera ha sido sobresaliente y el cuadro de Martiricos tiene bien atado su futuro con el de la Axarquía con un contrato hasta junio de 2029.

articles.title: Abdul Abdulmalik: Â£1.5m-rated National League star asks to leave Boreham Wood
articles.summary: Boreham Wood forward Abdul Abdulmalik says he is "capable of reaching the top" after the National League side reject a Â£1.5m offer from Swedish club Djurgarden.
articles.body:
Boreham Wood forward Abdul Abdulmalik said he is "capable of reaching the top" after the National League side rejected a Â£1.5m offer from Swedish club Djurgarden.

The 23-year-old has been the subject of serious interest from the Swedish top-flight side, who had an offer of Â£1m rejected earlier this month.

Boreham Wood do not want to sell Abdulmalik, with manager Luke Garrard saying "he is our player" after the forward was left out of the London club's 3-0 victory over Forest Green on Saturday.

"Everyone at Boreham Wood FC and the incredible fans have played a massive part [in my journey]. You will always have my respect," Adbulmalik said in a statement released by his agent.

"With this said, I'm ready for the next challenge. I'm ready to prove to myself and those around me that I'm capable of reaching the top."

Abdulmalik enjoyed a breakout season in 2025-26, scoring 17 goals and providing 10 assists as Boreham Wood reached the National League play-off final, where he scored and assisted at Wembley.

Djurgarden's Â£1.5m offer would have broken the record fee paid for a fifth-tier player in England, set in 2012 when Leicester paid Fleetwood Town Â£1m for Jamie Vardy.

"Through sheer hard work and perseverance, the opportunity to progress has come around. This is my chance to push myself as a footballer, elevate my game and most importantly fulfil my promise to the ones around me," Abdulmalik continued.

"Opportunities like this are rare, especially within the National League where some of the hardest working talent is overlooked.

"The game of football is forever changing and decisions are fast paced. There's no guarantee that the same chances come knocking twice.

"I owe it to myself and the kids growing up just like me to fight for this one I've been offered."

Abdulmalik came through Millwall's academy, progressing through the club's youth system and representing England at under-17 level.

He was part of the club's Under-21s successes - securing consecutive Professional Development League South titles in 2022-23 and 2023-24.

However, a pathway into consistent first-team football did not materialise and Abdulmalik was released in 2024, before Boreham Wood signed him as a free agent.

BBC Sport has contacted Boreham Wood for comment.

articles.standfirst: Espera cerrar dos llegadas y cuatro salidas en los últimos días del mercado. Ya en enero los fichajes llegaron en el último momento, algo habitual en sus anteriores equipos
articles.summary: Espera cerrar dos llegadas y cuatro salidas en los últimos días del mercado. Ya en enero los fichajes llegaron en el último momento, algo habitual en sus anteriores equipos
articles.body: Dos operaciones de entrada y cuatro de salida. Esa es la hoja de ruta marcada por Mateu Alemany en estos últimos días de mercado. Fichar un 9 (Nico Jackson es la prioridad) y recuperar a Nico Gonzalez, en el primer apartado. Colocar a Giménez, Lemar, Carlos Martín y Obed Vargas en un espacio de tiempo que es territorio Mateu. Porque cuando las ventanas de fichaje agonizan llega el momento del balear. No hay que viajar en el tiempo para descubrirlo. En su primer mercado como rojiblanco, el invernal, Mateu consiguió cerrar sus tres incorporaciones en las últimas 72 horas. Primero, con el fichaje estelar de Lookman, al que se le colocaba en Turquía hasta la aparición rojiblanca desvelada por MARCA. Luego, con la llegada sorprendente de Obed Vargas... que rejuveneció la medular junto al fichaje en el cierre del mercado de Rodrigo Mendoza, una de las grandes joyas del fútbol español. La habilidad del balear para cerrar operaciones al final del mercado viene de lejos. En el verano de 2021 consiguió la cesión de Luuk de Jong mientras lograba cerrar la salida de Antoine Griezmann, también a préstamo, rumbo al Atlético de Madrid. Junto al francés se marchó Emerson Royal al Tottenham. No sólo apuró como azulgrana en los mercados veraniegos, más dados a operaciones por la disposición económica más solvente. En el invierno de 2022 llevó al Camp Nou a Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang:, que se cerró en los últimos minutos del 31 de enero, tras lograr que el jugador rescindiera su contrato con el Arsenal para llegar libre. Adama Traoré también llegó a préstamo cuando el mercado agonizaba.  Antes de arribar en el Barça, Mateu lideró el último gran Valencia. En Mestalla dejó un grato recuerdo y operaciones de última hora como las de un Gonzalo Guedes que es, sin duda, su momento álgido en cuanto a fichajes postreros. El futbolista, que ya había estado en Mestalla un año antes, acabó como valencianista a escasos tres días de mercado tras sacar Alemany al jugador del PSG por una importante cantidad de 40 millones de euros. Un año antes ya había firmado operaciones de calado con Andreas Pereira y Kondogbia, dos más de los nombres que logró abrochar en el llamado Territorio Mateu.

articles.title: Gianni Infantino: Irish FA withdraws support for Fifa president
articles.summary: The Irish Football Association says it is "time for change" at Fifa and they will not be voting for president Gianni Infantino's re-election next year.
articles.body:
The Irish Football Association says it is "time for change" at Fifa and they will not be voting for president Gianni Infantino's re-election next year.

Infantino has been under increasing scrutiny since his aborted attempt to sell off a 21% stake in Fifa's commercial operations to a private investment company.

The plans were scrapped after widespread criticism, with Uefa threatening a boycott of all Fifa competitions.

The IFA, the governing body for football in Northern Ireland, had previously backed Uefa's stance without formally withdrawing their support, but have now said Infantino's plan raised "fundamental questions" of the president.

It said in a statement: "The proposal to sell part of Fifa's assets to a private equity firm without consultation, represents more than a failure of communication. In our view, it raises fundamental questions about strategy, governance and stewardship of our assets.

"We believe the time has come for change."

The Football Associations of England, Scotland, Wales and the Republic of Ireland have previously publicly withdrawn support for Infantino , who is scheduled to stand for a fourth term as president in March.

Should the 56-year-old Swiss be successful, by the end of the term in 2031, his tenure will have been extended to 15 years.

articles.title: Carlos Baleba transfer: Manchester United complete signing of Cameroon midfielder from Brighton
articles.summary: Sky Sports News has been reporting on United's interest in Baleba since last autumn and broke the news that they enquired about signing him during the January transfer window; the Cameroon international signs a five-year deal at Old Trafford
articles.body:
Manchester United have completed the signing of midfielder Carlos Baleba from Brighton.

The Cameroon international, 22, joins the club in a deal worth up to £70m, made up of a £65m guaranteed fee plus £5m in add-ons.

He has signed a five-year contract which includes the option of a further year.

Baleba is currently injured, having picked up an ankle injury in pre-season, but Sky Sports News understands he could be back by mid-September. Manchester United play Manchester City on September 13, live on Sky Sports.

  • Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream PL games with no contract📺

Baleba's arrival at Old Trafford brings an end to a transfer saga that has lasted almost 12 months. Sky Sports News has been reporting on United's interest in Baleba since last autumn and broke the news that they enquired about signing him during the January transfer window.

He remained one of United's top targets this summer and becomes their third addition in midfield after Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans.

"It is an incredible feeling to join the club of my dreams. Playing at Old Trafford is always special but the opportunity to do so as a Manchester United player will be a real honour," Baleba told the club's website.

"I cannot wait to work with Michael Carrick; his experience and knowledge of the game make him the perfect coach to help me reach the highest level.

"The ambition of everyone at the club is extremely clear, the future is hugely exciting, and I am determined to play my part in delivering the success that we are capable of together."

Baleba joined Brighton from Lille in 2023 and made 112 appearances for the club. He featured 35 times last season and was absent for a spell while representing Cameroon at the Africa Cup of Nations.

'I had no idea what this club would become' - Baleba pens Brighton farewell

Upon the announcement of the news, Baleba took to social media to post an emotional farewell to Brighton.

"I came here at 19 with little English and no idea what this club would become to me," he wrote.

"Brighton only asked me to be myself. The staff who make the club run so well. The team-mates who took the time to understand me, on the pitch and off it. The nights at the Amex when I heard my name from that stand always made me feel at home.

"To all of the fans, staff and my team-mates. You looked after me and for that I will hold you all close to my heart. Wherever I play, this club is in how I play. Good luck Seagulls."

Is Baleba a major gamble or a game-changer for Man Utd?

Analysis by Sky Sports' William Bitibiri:

A year ago, Carlos Baleba appeared to have the world at his feet.

A breakout season at Brighton had established the then-21-year-old as one of the Premier League's most coveted young midfielders, with a move to one of Europe's elite clubs seemingly inevitable. Manchester United were among those interested, having identified Baleba as a potential transformative presence in midfield.

But Brighton's reported £100m-plus valuation proved a stumbling block. The move never materialised and Baleba stayed at the Amex.

His form subsequently dipped dramatically. His numbers fell and, at times, he looked a shadow of the midfielder who had generated so much excitement the previous season.

That makes this a gamble for United. But, stylistically, there are few midfielders better suited to what they need.

United require greater authority in the middle of the pitch and, crucially, someone capable of winning the ball back in deeper areas. Baleba brings exactly that. His athleticism, aggression and ability to carry the ball through midfield would add a level of dynamism and steel that is currently missing.

Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans have been astute additions, but Baleba offers something different: specialist defensive power coupled with the athleticism to drive United up the pitch.

His age is another major factor. Baleba is still only 22 and, despite his inconsistent season, there remains a belief around him that he can develop into one of the world's best midfielders.

That ambition is reflected in his influences. Baleba has spoken of his admiration for Paul Pogba, Yaya Toure and Andres Iniesta, while Neymar and Ronaldinho were among his favourite players to watch. There is a desire for self-expression in his game that goes beyond the physical qualities that made so highly rated.

There is risk attached to signing him. United would be betting on the player Baleba can become rather than simply the one he has been over the past 12 months.

But if United want to find a midfielder capable of growing into one of the best in his position, this is exactly the sort of gamble they should be willing to take.

articles.summary: Following in the Big Ten's footsteps, the ACC is reportedly considering a rule change that could prohibit schools from adding players who were previously in the NFL.
articles.body:
Following in the Big Ten's footsteps, the ACC is reportedly considering a rule change that could prohibit schools from adding players who were previously in the NFL.

On Tuesday, the Big Ten reportedly passed a rule preventing NFL players from returning to college, per ESPN's Pete Thamel.

Now the ACC is looking to pass a similar rule, per Ralph D. Russo, Chris Vannini, Scott Dochterman and Seth Emerson of The Athletic .

"The ACC is considering a similar conference-wide rule, Wake Forest athletic director and ACC athletic director chair John Currie told The Athletic. The league's athletic directors have a regularly scheduled meeting Wednesday, and this discussion will be part of the agenda."

The Big 12 is reporting considering a similar ban, per Ross Dellenger of Yahoo Sports.

On Monday, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported that undrafted free agent tight end Dae'Quan Wright, who was waived by the Cleveland Browns, has an agreement to play for LSU.

A Louisiana judge's temporary restraining order has carved the path for Wright to return to college, where he played for Virginia Tech in 2022 and 2023 and Ole Miss in 2024 and 2025.

Wright is among 33 athletes who can could gain an extra collegiate season. He is one of three athletes who signed with a pro team but can choose that path alongside running back Anthony Hankerson (Miami Dolphins and Seattle Seahawks) and linebacker Jack Pyburn (Tampa Bay Buccaneers). Hankerson has been waived, while Pyburn is still on the Bucs' roster.

Some big-name coaches had mixed opinions on NFL players returning to college. Oregon head coach Dan Lanning was clearly opposed to it, while Ohio State head coach Ryan Day was at least open to the matter.

The Big Ten has ultimately shut the door on the possibility. The ACC may follow suit.

The SEC doesn't like the practice either and released a statement on the matter, but there wasn't word on whether the conference would pass a rule banning it.

It seems like a common-sense move to ban pro players from returning to school. The situation still has to play itself out, though, as news continuously develops on the matter.

articles.summary: El formato se mantiene respecto de las dos temporadas anteriores
articles.body: La UEFA Champions League 2026/27 arrancará su 72.ª edición histórica (la 35.ª bajo el nombre de Liga de Campeones y la tercera estrenando la fase de liga). El torneo echó a andar el 7 de julio de 2026 con la clasificación previa y bajará el telón el 5 de junio de 2027 con la gran final en el Estadio Metropolitano de Madrid. El formato se mantiene respecto de las dos temporadas anteriores. Los 36 clubes estarán reunidos en una única tabla y cada uno disputará ocho partidos contra ocho adversarios diferentes: cuatro como local y cuatro como visitante. Los ocho mejores clasificarán directamente a octavos de final, mientras que los ubicados entre el noveno y el vigesimocuarto puesto deberán disputar los playoffs de la fase eliminatoria. Los equipos que finalicen del puesto 25 al 36 quedarán eliminados. La primera jornada de la fase liga tendrá una particularidad: se desarrollará durante tres días, del 8 al 10 de septiembre. El resto de las fechas se disputará principalmente entre martes y miércoles. El Estadio Metropolitano albergará por segunda vez el partido decisivo el sábado 5 de junio de 2027. En 2019, la casa del Atlético de Madrid presenció el triunfo del Liverpool frente al Tottenham (2-0) para alzarse con su sexta corona europea. Con esta cita, Madrid albergará por sexta ocasión la final de la máxima competición continental, solo superada por Londres en número de finales albergadas.

articles.title: Tennessee LB Arion Carter's Suspension Over $427 Flight Reduced by NCAA
articles.summary: Tennessee linebacker Arion Carter had his suspension regarding a flight payment reduced to one game by the NCAA, Volunteers athletic director Danny White announced Tuesday.
articles.body:
Tennessee linebacker Arion Carter had his suspension regarding a flight payment reduced to one game by the NCAA, Volunteers athletic director Danny White announced Tuesday.

Carter initially received a two-game suspension on July 29 after his agent paid $427 for a flight to an NFL training facility during the offseason. He later paid the agent back for the flight.

The NCAA originally suspended Carter three games for the Level III violation before the Volunteers appealed the penalty and had it reduced, according to ESPN's Mark Schlabach .

The 21-year-old played through a foot injury near the end of last season and declared for the 2026 NFL draft in Dec. 2025, but ultimately returned to Tennessee after aggravating the injury and undergoing surgery.

Carter is expected to be a key piece of a deep Volunteers linebacking corps that includes Amare Campbell, Edwin Spillman and Jeremiah Telander.

In 10 games last season, Carter racked up 76 tackles, six tackles for loss, two passes defended, 1.5 sacks and one forced fumble.

Tennessee is looking to remain a threat in the SEC during its 2026 campaign after recording double-digit win totals in two of the past four years.

While Carter will still miss the Volunteers' season-opening clash with Furman on Sept. 5, he'll now be available to suit up during a matchup with Georgia Tech on Sept. 12.

articles.title: 5-Star OT Austin Attalah Announces CFB Commitment Between Texas, Texas Tech, USC
articles.summary: The college football season kicks off this week, but Texas Tech has already scored a win thanks to top offensive tackle recruit Austin Attalah.
articles.body:
The college football season kicks off this week, but Texas Tech has already scored a win thanks to top offensive tackle recruit Austin Attalah.

Attalah told Hayes Fawcett of Rivals.com on Tuesday that he will join the Red Raiders as part of their 2028 recruiting class. The California native picked Texas Tech over Texas and USC.

247Sports' composite rankings have Attalah rated as a 5-star prospect, the third-best offensive tackle and No. 27 overall recruit in 2028.

In his scouting evaluation of Attalah for 247Sports, Gabe Brooks described his hand work and punch power as "works in progress" but the ceiling is that of a "high-major tackle who could become a pro prospect."

Attalah's commitment is yet another recruiting win for head coach Joey McGuire. Texas Tech has been among the best programs in the nation at landing new talent over the past two years.

The 2025 season saw the Red Raiders finish with the No. 2 transfer portal class in the country thanks to additions like David Bailey and Romello Height.

That group helped catapult Texas Tech to a 12-2 record, its first double-digit win season since 2008 and its first-ever Big 12 title. The team made the College Football Playoff as the No. 4 seed, but lost its first playoff game to Oregon in the quarterfinal.

McGuire and his staff have been able to carry that momentum over into 2026 and beyond. The incoming freshman class this year is ranked 15th nationally, led by 5-star tackle Felix Ojo.

It's still very early in the 2028 recruiting cycle, but Attalah is one of two players the Red Raiders have landed thus far. The other is punter Luc Normand.

Texas Tech will open this season ranked No. 12 in the Associated Press Top 25 poll, its highest spot in the preseason poll since 2008. The Red Raiders will open the year against Abilene Christian on Sept. 5.

articles.standfirst: El mediocentro, con experiencia en Segunda división, procede del Estoril Praia portugués
articles.summary: El mediocentro, con experiencia en Segunda división, procede del Estoril Praia portugués
articles.body: El Cádiz ha hecho oficial el fichaje de Jandro Orellana. El club amarillo ha alcanzado un acuerdo con el Estoril Praia para el traspaso del mediocentro catalán, que firma hasta junio de 2030 y ya trabaja bajo las órdenes de Albert Celades. Nacido en Gavá el 7 de agosto de 2000, Orellana llega al Nuevo Mirandilla con experiencia tanto en Segunda como en la máxima categoría portuguesa. Se formó en las categorías inferiores del Espanyol y el Barcelona antes de iniciar su trayectoria en el fútbol profesional. Dos años después fue traspasado al Estoril, con el que acumuló otros 42 encuentros en la primera división de Portugal. A sus 26 años, Orellana aumenta las alternativas de Celades en el centro del campo y se convierte en una apuesta de largo recorrido para el Cádiz. Su conocimiento de la categoría debería facilitar su adaptación a un equipo que ha apostado por rejuvenecer su plantilla y dar protagonismo a futbolistas con margen de crecimiento. El mediocentro ya se encuentra integrado en la dinámica del conjunto amarillo y podría entrar próximamente en los planes del entrenador. El Cádiz incorpora así experiencia, recorrido y competencia para una de las zonas que buscaba reforzar antes del cierre del mercado.

articles.title: Liam Delap: Nottingham Forest agree Â£50m deal for Chelsea striker
articles.summary: Nottingham Forest have agreed a fee worth around Â£50m to sign Chelsea striker Liam Delap.
articles.body:
Nottingham Forest have agreed a club-record fee worth around Â£50m to sign Chelsea striker Liam Delap.

The 23-year-old is expected to undergo a medical and sign a long-term contract at the City Ground this week.

Delap's move comes a year after he joined Chelsea from Ipswich Town for Â£30m amid competition from Manchester United and Everton .

However, Chelsea made him available for sale this summer after he scored just one Premier League goal in a previous campaign disrupted by shoulder and hamstring injuries.

Forest have already signed defender Ousmane Diomande from Sporting for Â£34m, alongside free agents, Austrian midfielder Xaver Schlager and goalkeeper Steve Benda.

They sold England midfielder Elliot Anderson to Manchester City for a club-record Â£116m and striker Taiwo Awoniyi to Coventry City for Â£9m.

Delap's arrival would provide competition for strikers Chris Wood and Igor Jesus, who failed to find the target in Forest's 1-0 defeat by Leeds in their home Premier League opener on Saturday.

Chelsea have also signed two strikers this summer in Emmanuel Emegha from Strasbourg and Danny Welbeck from Brighton .

Delap came up through Derby County's youth system before joining Manchester City in 2019.

After helping City win the FA Youth Cup in the 2019-20 campaign, he scored 24 goals in 20 Premier League 2 matches in 2020-21 as they won the title.

In September 2020 the striker scored on his senior City debut in a 2-1 League Cup win against Bournemouth , and three days later made his Premier League debut in a 5-2 defeat by Leicester.

Injuries played a part in limiting further first-team opportunities, and between 2022 and 2024 Delap spent time on loan in the Championship with Stoke, Preston North End and Hull City .

In the summer of 2024 he was sold for Â£20m by City to Ipswich and scored 12 goals in 37 Premier League games for the newly promoted side.

articles.standfirst: Vuelve cedido por el Milan con opción de compra
articles.summary: Vuelve cedido por el Milan con opción de compra
articles.body: El Leipzig acaba de confirmar la vuelta de uno de los futbolistas que se convirtió en ídolo en el Red Bull Arena, Christopher Nkunku. El francés llega en calidad de cedido para jugar esta temporada, aunque tiene opción de compra en caso de convencer a los alemanes con su rendimiento. Se convirtió en su momento en una de las mayores venta del Leipzig. En en 2019 llegó por menos de 20 millones de euros y aportó 70 goles y 56 asistencias en 172 partidos, ganando por el camino dos Copas y el trofeo a máximo goleador de la Bundesliga en la 22/23 (empatado con Füllkrug). Cuatro años después, el Chelsea pagó por él 60 millones de euros.  Sin embargo, nunca volvió a ser el que se vio en Alemania. Las lesiones le lastraron. A las pocas semanas de llegar a Londres, se lesionó el menisco. Varias dolencias más le privaron de ser regular en el conjunto 'blue'. Debido a la 'sobrepoblación' de la plantilla, tuvo que salir traspasado al Milan el pasado verano, donde ha visto puerta ocho ocasiones en 35 encuentros. Este año, no contaba para Ruben Amorim, nuevo entrenador del cuadro italiano, por lo que ha decidido regresar cedido al lugar donde mostró su mejor versión. Un Leipzig falto de gol. La temporada pasada fue el equipo de los clasificados a Champions de la liga alemana que menos tantos metieron. Solo Baumgartner y Diomandé superaron las 10 anotaciones, y el costamarfileño ya no está, por lo que la llegada de Nkunku puede suponer un gran movimiento.

articles.title: Lane Kiffin Reacts to 'Villain' Label After Recruiting NFL's Dae'Quan Wright, Zxavian Harris to LSU
articles.summary: LSU head coach Lane Kiffin isn't concerned with labels as he tries to restore his team to national championship contention.
articles.body:
LSU head coach Lane Kiffin isn't concerned with labels as he tries to restore his team to national championship contention.

During an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show on Tuesday, Kiffin was asked about the "villain" label he's received since landing commitments from former Cleveland Browns tight end Dae'Quan Wright and former New Orleans Saints defensive end Zxavian Harrison."

"I don't worry too much about that," Kiffin replied. "I think as you talk about villains, sometimes the difference between the hero and the villain isn't very far apart, and it changes very often. ... When you're trying to do things at the highest level, a lot of times people want you to apologize for what you're doing when you're chasing greatness."

According to the Associated Press , Wright was among a group of athletes who filed a lawsuit in Louisiana seeking a fifth year of college eligibility for members of the high school class of 2022. The court issued a temporary restraining order that paved the way for him and others to return to college athletics.

Kiffin noted on Tuesday that he's not the only coach who is trying to make use of the loopholes in the NCAA's eligibility rules.

Kiffin went on to add that while he understands the concerns about professional athletes trying to gain advantages by returning to college, he feels that doesn't apply to this situation because of the specific circumstances surrounding the 2022 class' chances of a fifth year of eligibility.

"There's a lot of parts that I don't like within that. I don't think professionals should come back to college sports and college football, particularly," Kiffin said. "But in this instance, this is not professionals that have gone and played seasons or just randomly filed an injunction in a state to become eligible. This is part of a specific class that was ruled wronged by the NCAA that was supposed to be five for five."

Still, the situation undoubtedly creates more questions than answers in the ever-changing landscape of college sports, so it will be interesting to see how the NCAA responds going forward.

articles.summary: El club vigués hace oficial el fichaje del extremo procedente de PSV
articles.body: El Celta hizo oficial este martes su quinta incorporación cara a la presente temporada. Couhaib Driouech firma por el club vigués por cuatro temporadas, hasta junio de 2030. Por el traspaso del extremo, el Celta pagará al PSV una cantidad cercana a los 7 millones. Es el primer desembolso que el club vigués realiza este verano, ya que Aleix Febas y Javi Galán llegaron con la carta de libertad y Faye y Bayindir lo hicieron cedidos. Driouech, de 24 años, nació en los Países Bajos y tiene ascendencia marroquí. En los dos últimos años en PSV ha disputado 61 encuentros oficiales en los que ha marcado 12 goles y dado 10 asistencias. En todo ese periodo disputó Champions, competición en la que jugó 12 partidos, hizo 4 goles y dio 2 asistencias. El Celta recibe al futbolista, señalando: “Driouech es un extremo diestro que se desenvuelve principalmente en la banda izquierda, aunque también puede actuar por el costado derecho. articles.title: Liam Delap transfer: Nottingham Forest agree club-record deal to sign Chelsea striker
articles.summary: Nottingham Forest have agreed a club-record £50m deal to sign Liam Delap from Chelsea; striker moved to Stamford Bridge last summer, but scored just two goals in 41 games for the club; Chelsea could make a £20m profit having signed the 23-year-old for £30m
articles.body:
Nottingham Forest have agreed a club-record £50m deal to sign Liam Delap from Chelsea.

The transfer is understood to be worth at least £45m, which could reach £50m with add-ons.

The striker is scheduled to have a medical on Wednesday.

  • Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream PL games with no contract📺

Delap had interest from a number of other Premier League clubs, including Everton, but Forest have secured his signing.

Chelsea signed Delap last summer for £30m from Ipswich and valued him at around £50m this summer.

They could be set for a £20m profit on a striker who scored two goals in 41 appearances last season.

Forest's previous record transfer saw Omari Hutchison join for £37.5m from Ipswich Town in August 2025.

Sherwood backs Forest's Delap move

Tim Sherwood speaking on Soccer Special:

"We know Liam's got the ability; he's shown that in the past. He needs to play on a regular basis now. He needs to stay fit.

"It never worked out at Chelsea. I never think he ever got a run in the team to give that striker the confidence; you need the manager to love you and play you every week, even if you're not playing well. I think he'll get that with Glasner - you've seen that with (Jean-Philippe Mateta) at Palace.

"He [Forest boss Oliver Glasner] likes to play with a big striker; he likes support. If he [Delap] can keep up with play, I think he'll score goals for Nottingham Forest, and I believe he will keep up with play.

"I think he's aggressive; he's got a lot of attributes to be a top, top striker, but Chelsea just did not work for him, and that's what happens.

"Forget about the price tag because the price tags all over the Premier League now are just ridiculous."

What other business could Forest do?

Forest are bringing in Delap to improve their striking options following Taiwo Awoniyi's £9m move to Coventry.

Oliver Glasner's side have been pursuing Tottenham midfielder Lucas Bergvall as an Elliot Anderson replacement, but Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi insists he is staying in north London.

Forest could also add a right wing-back, with Dodo at Fiorentina a player of interest.

Dilane Bakwa is set to join Lille on loan, while centre-backs Zach Abbott and Tyler Bindon could also depart on temporary moves amid interest from Watford.
authors: Mark McAdam, Anton Toloui & James Savundra

articles.title: No more secret deals: AIFF asks clubs to disclose player salaries in full
articles.summary: Football News: Panaji: Itâs the worst kept secret in Indian football.A majority of the clubs in top tier Indian Super League (ISL) are known to be way above the sala.
articles.body: Panaji: Itâs the worst kept secret in Indian football.A majority of the clubs in top tier Indian Super League (ISL) are known to be way above the salary cap of Rs 16.5 crore. Besides a standard player contract, clubs sign bonus letters, image rights agreement and have other arrangements, which includes employment in parent companies, to stay within the salary cap.Yet, all these years, no club has been pulled up for flouting the salary cap. Thereâs been rules in place âaction/sanction by the league which includes fine and/or deduction of points,â but clubs donât care, simply because nobody has bothered with the implementation.Now, the All India Football Federation (AIFF) has made it mandatory for all clubs to upload side letters and allied contractual documents, alongside player employment contracts, on the Centralised Registration System (CRS). The mandatory uploading of all accompanying documents and side letters will strictly apply to all transactions registered during the ongoing transfer window from June 1 to August 31, 2026.âAny failure, suppression, concealment or omission by a club to upload complete contractual documents and side letters on the CRS shall be deemed a violation of the AIFF regulations and procedural norms, rendering the concerned entity subject to appropriate disciplinary proceedings and sanctions,â AIFF deputy secretary general M Satyanarayan wrote to all state associations on Sunday.Satyanarayan said the circular is being issued pursuant to a recent decision of the AIFF players' status committee in the matter of Sahil Tavora vs Jindal Football Pvt Ltd, who took over Hyderabad FC and later renamed it to Sporting Club Delhi.According to the PSC, it was discovered upon verification that Tavoraâs FC Goa Employment Agreement was uploaded on the CRS, whereas the corresponding FC Goa Image Rights Agreement -- â worth Rs 65 lakh for two years â had not been uploaded.Tavora also did not make any mention of the separate image rights agreement while pursuing his dues from Hyderabad FC. His lawyer contended that the FC Goa Image Rights Agreement should not be considered for the purpose of mitigation, as the payments do not fall within the definition of âremunerationâ under Article 20.âThe committee is unable to accept this submission,â PSC chairperson Justice Ravindra Singh noted in his order last week. âThe committee notes that the Side Letter, Player Bonus Agreement(s) executed between Hyderabad FC and the player were taken into account as part of the playerâs contractual remuneration for determining his claim. Accordingly, the player cannot selectively contend that one contractual benefit should be considered for determining his entitlement, while another contractual benefit should be excluded when assessing his mitigation.âSignificantly, PSC rejected and dismissed the claim instituted by Tavora.Salary cap is the maximum expenditure a club is permitted to spend on player signings. It includes individual performance bonus (exclusive of team bonus), agent/intermediary fees and separate arrangements with players.According to the League rules, salary cap is âneeded to maintain a healthy competitive balance.âGet the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Julian Alvarez transfer latest: Atletico standing firm on Barcelona as Arsenal become only get out for Argentine striker
articles.summary: Julian Alvarez is holding out for a move to Barcelona, but Atletico Madrid are standing firm on the refusal to sell to their LaLiga rivals; Atletico football expert Ruben Uría believes the only way out for Alvarez is to join Premier League champions Arsenal
articles.body:
Julian Alvarez must take one of two paths before the transfer deadline: stay at Atletico Madrid and try to rebuild his connection with the fans or get his head around a potential move to Arsenal.

Atletico have told him again that they will not sell him to Barcelona and that - coupled with the reaction of the club's supporters on Sunday - has left him "devastated", according to well-placed sources in Spain.

The situation is now "extremely tense", according to Atletico expert and journalist Ruben Uría.

"Neither Miguel Gil Marín (CEO of Atlético Madrid) nor the Apollo board want to sell the player to Barcelona," he told Sky Sports News. "The entire Apollo board supports Gil Marín's decision. Alvarez has been told."

According to Uría, Arsenal sporting director Andrea Berta has remained in contact with his former Atletico employers in recent days after Alvarez was booed off by supporters in the opening LaLiga game against Villarreal.

But Arsenal will need Alvarez to put Barcelona out of his mind and show he really wants to join Mikel Arteta's project before any serious negotiations or any offers can be made. In that vein, Arsenal are not currently hopeful of getting him in before September 1 and they are certainly not currently expecting it at the Emirates.

  • Arsenal fixtures & scores | FREE Arsenal highlights▶️
  • Got Sky? Watch Premier League games LIVE on your phone📱
  • Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream PL games with no contract📺

Alvarez still has his heart set on Barcelona. The question is, will this be the case as the transfer window comes to an end? Will the deadline have any effect? Arsenal will always be ready and open to Alvarez should he change his mind but, at the moment, any move looks very unlikely.

If Alvarez shifts his thinking before the end and pushes for an escape, Atletico are believed to be ready to listen to offers of around £130m (€150m) from Arsenal. Indeed, according to Uría, some people around the Argentine think it is increasingly impossible for him to stay at Atletico given the current atmosphere.

Should Arsenal complete a deal for Alvarez, it would be the 10th £100m+ signing in Premier League history.

It would also be the fourth this summer, after Morgan Rogers' switch to Chelsea, Elliot Anderson's move to Manchester City and Sandro Tonali joining Tottenham.

Uría also told Sky Sports News: "Julian and his agent believe that everything that's happening is the fault of Gil Marín, Atletico Madrid's CEO, who publicly asked them to say they wanted to leave Atletico.

"For their part, Atletico Madrid argues that Julian already knew how Atletico played under Diego Simeone when he signed for the club, that he knew what contract he was signing and what its clause was, and they deny that Atletico told him he could leave for a direct rival.

"We are waiting to see how events unfold regarding Julian, waiting to see how Arsenal reacts, and if they have genuine interest in the Argentina player. Atletico Madrid will not sell to Barcelona.

"Our information today is that the Julian Alvarez situation has become very tense, and according to several reliable sources, right now, in this crucial week, there are only two paths: stay at Atletico Madrid to fulfil his contract or listen to Arsenal's offer and sign for the London club. Julian will have to make his decision."
authors: Ruben Uría, Lyall Thomas & Rob Dorsett
